assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: ONE production desktop file-type icon for the Backleaf Windows file manager, word-processing documents (Word DOCX). Design one polished, quietly beautiful, macOS-quality document icon: a warm white upright sheet with a small folded upper-right corner and gently softened corners; one large clear deep muted-blue W in its lower-middle as the content cue, plus at most two very subtle short document lines. Front-facing, optically balanced, almost flat with a tiny amount of material depth from the folded corner only. Broad confident shapes, restrained color, sharp silhouette and crisp antialiased edges, readable at 24 and 44 px. The W must be centered, clearly legible, unbranded geometric lettering, not a pasted official app tile. Aesthetic: calm contemporary product iconography, coherent with a restrained white/blue-gray file manager. Genuine transparent background with alpha. Square canvas; paper occupies 72 percent of height, centered with equal optical breathing room. The entire sheet and fold fit inside the image. No rounded-square outer tile or background container, no separate colored rectangle behind the letter, no floor, no cast shadow beyond one subtle contact edge on the paper itself. No glow, gradient backdrop, long shadow, glossy 3D, textures, chrome, extra text, filename, watermark, border around the canvas, multiple icons, or presentation sheet. One finished icon only.
